remarks: Beautiful land in Frewsburg. Great place to build a dream home, hunting cabin, farming or development. Panoramic country views. Creek runs through the property. Currently has a hunting “shed” on site. Zoned agriculture residential so many possible uses. Approximately 16 acres of cleared land and the rest is wooded with trails. Not too far out but gives the feel of complete peace and privacy. There was once a home here so utilities are nearby. The driveway still exists as well.
